question: Should LINE's default webhook ACK timing move from after_receive_record to after_agent_dispatch so startup-time dispatch failures return 500 for provider redelivery?
rationale: This is a compatibility and delivery-policy choice: the patch is coherent, but it intentionally changes the shipped failure response that existing LINE deployments observe.

options.title: Approve Dispatch-Acceptance Default
options.body: Land the PR as-is once the LINE owner accepts provider redelivery for startup-time dispatch failures.

options.title: Keep Immediate ACK Default
options.body: Ask for a revision that preserves after_receive_record as the runtime default and exposes dispatch-acceptance only where explicitly selected.

options.title: Defer For Durable Retry Design
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want a broader durable queue or retry contract instead of a one-turn startup failure check.

recommendation.title: Approve Dispatch-Acceptance Default
recommendation.body: Land the PR as-is once the LINE owner accepts provider redelivery for startup-time dispatch failures.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the previous LINE ACK fix that defines the current shipped behavior this PR changes.
